info.description: WebX Agent conversation + run history (webx-studio's own bookkeeping — see lib/agent/threads.ts). Never written through the generic entries route; see governance.ts's assertBookkeepingWriteAllowed.

tenantKey.description: Plain string, not a relation — same shape as page-version/custom-role/page-template, deliberately avoiding a relation-id lookup for what's pure bookkeeping metadata.

context.description: {kind:'page'|'entry'|'board'|'none', uid?, id?, locale?} — what the thread was opened against, for the workspace's own thread list.

messages.description: Trimmed to the last ~40 messages by lib/agent/threads.ts; not a full unbounded transcript.

runState.description: idle|running|done|error — named runState, not status: Strapi 5's content-manager reserves "status" as a system field (document draft/published state) on every collection type regardless of draftAndPublish, and rejects a custom attribute using that name outright (found live: POST here 400s with ValidationError "Invalid status" the moment a payload sets it).

checkpoint.description: Engine RunCheckpoint (webx-studio lib/agent/engine/types.ts) for a run that stopped before finishing and can be continued. Null once a run ends for good. Capped at ~256KB by app/api/agent/run; never sent to the browser.
